problems: Fix pass on the three dossiers with verdict fail (hungarian-republic, kingdom-of-romania, yugoslavia); kingdom-of-lithuania and republic-of-austria (pass) and second-polish-republic (thin) were not touched. All three touched dossiers validate with --resolve (0 errors, 0 warnings). events_total and sources_total count all six dossiers of the batch (the three untouched ones as in the first report: 15, 9 and 34 events; 6, 2 and 6 sources). fixes_applied counts the 12 review findings not yet applied (hungarian-republic 1, kingdom-of-romania 3, yugoslavia 8); five thin items were also filled (month of the 1941 Hungarian annexation, German occupation end and Soviet conquest and occupation of Hungary, Transnistria end, Julian March occupation).

No disagreement with the reviewer. The Hungarian /ledger 1945 loss of southern Slovakia and Ruthenia (confidence 1) was left unchanged on the reviewer's own advice: no page opened dates the return, and czechoslovakia books the strip from slovak-republic, so the mirror must be fixed there. The 'serbia' dossier (Macedonian-front remnant) is kept as a second predecessor of yugoslavia next to serbs; drop that predecessor entry if the orchestrator removes the dossier.

Pages read in the fix pass: Hungarian-Romanian War, Treaty of Trianon, First Vienna Award, Hungary in World War II, Hungarian occupation of Yugoslav territories, First Austrian Republic, Julian March, Transnistria Governorate, Banat, Kingdom of Yugoslavia, Axis occupation of Yugoslavia, Operational Zone of the Adriatic Littoral, Second Vienna Award. The Yugoslav Front page loaded twice but the text stops before 1945, so it is not cited.

Routing for other batches. yugoslav-partisans: no gain of Backa and Baranja (October 1944; hungarian-republic now names yugoslav-partisans), no Kosovo, and its dissolve names no counterpart (should be yugoslavia). nazi-germany: no occupation of northern Slovenia 1941-1945, and it ends its occupation of Hungary in May 1945 where the Hungary in World War II page gives 4 April 1945. czechoslovakia: books southern Slovakia from slovak-republic, not hungarian-republic. union-of-soviet-socialist-republics: no mirror of the Romanian occupation of Transnistria (ended March 1944), of the Soviet administration of Northern Transylvania (1944/10 - 1945/3), or of the Soviet contest and occupation of Hungary (1944/9 - 1946/2). kingdom-of-italy: books South Tyrol from austria-hungary, not republic-of-austria. republic-of-austria and yugoslavia now mirror each other on Lower Styria (1919/9) and the Carinthian contest (1919 - 1920/10).

The Romanian recognition of Transylvania (kingdom-of-romania, 1920/6, 'Transylvania (broad)', 390 cells) covers about 74 cells more than the hungarian-republic loss of June 1920 (316 cells: Transylvania plus the Romanian Banat); the extra cells are Crisana and Maramures, which the Trianon page does not name. The Moldavian Democratic Republic (Sfatul Tarii) is no longer a counterpart of kingdom-of-romania but remains one in united-principalities-of-moldavia-and-wallachia, so its dossier request in the first report stands.
